_about: Stage definitions for the evaluation (see eval/README.md). Stages are cumulative: each extends the one before and switches on one human-in-the-loop iteration. To try a teacher-requested refinement, add a new stage that extends the one being refined (e.g. "S3-v2": {"extends": "S3", ...}) and change fragments, extraRules, flags or snapshot; then run it and compare. Later stages can be re-pointed at an accepted refinement by changing their "extends".

S0.label: Basic RAG database and original prompt
S0.note: Original prompt with basic retrieval: similar rule cards + correction exemplars. End-of-story content check without the teacher's scene list.

S1.label: + Critique of AI feedback
S1.note: Teacher's 'My comment' critiques: rules 1-8, pinned ai_error_cards, structured output format.

S2.label: + Required-scene list
S2.note: End-of-story content check against the teacher's scene_list; per-scene rule 9 (no plot comments per scene).

S3.label: + Vocabulary error list
S3.note: Wrong words (用错的词) are errors under Grammar Corrections; vocab_error entries retrieved by regex triggers + similarity.

S4.label: + Coherence rules
S4.note: Coherence rules A-C, Coherence & Expressiveness section, pinned reference/了 rule cards, earlier scenes and model story as context. = production.

S1-v2.label: + Critique of AI feedback (relabelled)
S1-v2.note: Same as S1, but the AI-mistake cards are rebuilt from the new labels for all 67 critiqued AI items (no 'unclassified'), with examples chosen so more different critiques appear.

S1-v3.label: + Critique of AI feedback (relabelled, similar critiques retrieved)
S1-v3.note: S1-v2 plus, for each scene, the 3 critiqued AI items most similar to the scene (by embedding similarity), each with the teacher's verdict.

S5.label: + Vocabulary suggestion revision
S5.note: Teacher's comments on the S4 feedback: vocabulary suggestions only when clearly more appropriate in context (at most 3, none for acceptable words, never changing the meaning); the error section renamed Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections.

S5-v2.label: + Vocabulary suggestions guided by the teacher's examples
S5-v2.note: S5 with the teacher's official list of good vocabulary suggestions shown as models, and positive guidance: 1-3 suggestions per scene for correct but plain/general words, each checked in the student's sentence (same meaning, strength, collocation, tone).

S6.label: + Teacher's extra rules and definitions
S6.note: The teacher's 8 additional rules (extra rules.docx + general rules from her S5 comments) shown with the places they may apply; her 25 revised rule definitions on the rule cards; end-of-story feedback without scene numbers; vocabulary suggestions aimed at precision rather than formality.

S6-2pass.label: + Two-pass retrieval with structured output
S6-2pass.note: S6, but each scene runs in two passes: pass 1 lists candidate errors as JSON (span, category, rule); the teacher's rule card and labelled corrections are retrieved for each candidate; pass 2 writes the feedback as JSON. Every quoted span is checked against the student's text.
